description: Generate strong random passwords (8–128 chars; lower/upper/digits/symbols; skip look-alikes Il1|O0o; exclude your own characters; require every chosen set) or passphrases (3–12 words from the website's 2,381-word list, separator, capitalise, add a number). Returns 1–1000 results with exact entropy bits, a strength grade and the time to crack at 100 billion guesses/s. Always crypto random (OS CSPRNG, rejection sampling); nothing is stored or logged. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pass-forge/

addNumber.description: passphrase: append a number 0–99 to one random word.

avoidLookalikes.description: password: leave out I l 1 | O 0 o.

requireEachSet.description: password: at least one character from every chosen set.

separator.description: passphrase: between words ("" = none, words then capitalised).
